{{Quote|Break off the supply mission to Ord Mantell, we need to fall back!|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="CWA" />}}
The '''Ambush over Ord Mantell''' took place during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] above the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] supply storage [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] fleet was ambushed attempting to resupply his fleet.<ref name="CWA" />

==The battle==
When [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] fleet arrived in orbit over the weapons storage facility on Ord Mantell, several [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class frigates]] and a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ship]] were laying in wait right outside the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route. The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] fleet opened fire almost immediately destroying one of the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]]. Led by Skywalker the fleet was forced to break off their supply mission and fall back. Skywalker engaged the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces in his [[Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor]] along with [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] to hold off the onslaught while the fleet could plot a hyperspace route in the [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]].

With the Republic cruisers in disarray the Separatist fleet pressed their attack, launching [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] filled with [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1]] and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 battle droids]] to land on the Republic cruisers to take them over. However most of the droid landing craft were intercepted and destroyed by the V-19 Torrent [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and were unable to reach the nearby cruisers. The droids that did manage to land on the ships were quickly dispatched by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] who were stationed to defend the [[Hull/Legends|hull]]. With the threat of the battle droids infiltrating the cruisers quelled the V-19 Torrent starfighters attention was turned to the frigate's [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbo laser]]s and the [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] and [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|Hyena-class bombers]] bombarding the Republic cruisers, weakening their shields. Soon after an escape hyperspace route was plotted into the navigation computer and the Republic fighters where recalled to their cruisers.

With the Republic fleet finally out of harms way, Anakin Skywalker commended his clones bravery and skill. He then reported to command that the Separatists were laying in wait over Ord Mantell.<ref name="CWA" />
